service_or_situation: Producing documents on demand during a traffic stop
document_name: Driving Licence
expiry_consequence: Offence under OFF_NO_LICENCE if not produced/held

service_or_situation: Producing documents on demand during a traffic stop
document_name: Registration Certificate
expiry_consequence: Offence under OFF_NO_REGISTRATION if not produced/held

service_or_situation: Producing documents on demand during a traffic stop
document_name: Certificate of Insurance
expiry_consequence: Offence under OFF_NO_INSURANCE if not produced/held

service_or_situation: Producing documents on demand during a traffic stop
document_name: Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate
validity_period: typically 6 or 12 months depending on vehicle age/type (NOT_VERIFIED exact rule)
expiry_consequence: Offence under OFF_NO_PUC if not produced/held

service_or_situation: Producing documents on demand during a traffic stop (transport vehicles only)
document_name: Permit (goods/passenger carriage)
expiry_consequence: Offence under OFF_VEHICLE_WITHOUT_PERMIT if not held

service_or_situation: Producing documents on demand during a traffic stop (transport vehicles only)
document_name: Fitness Certificate
validity_period: 2 years (new transport vehicle), 1 year on renewal (commonly cited, NOT_VERIFIED)
expiry_consequence: Vehicle may be deemed unfit for use on public roads if expired

service_or_situation: Learners licence application
document_name: Age proof (birth certificate / school certificate / passport / Aadhaar)
expiry_consequence: Application rejected without valid age proof

service_or_situation: Learners licence application
document_name: Address proof (Aadhaar / voter ID / utility bill / passport)
expiry_consequence: Application rejected without valid address proof

service_or_situation: Permanent driving licence application (after learners licence period)
document_name: Valid Learners Licence number/document
validity_period: LL must be at least 30 days and not more than a prescribed maximum old (exact window NOT_VERIFIED)
expiry_consequence: Application not accepted outside the eligible LL window

service_or_situation: Permanent driving licence application
document_name: Driving test clearance (conducted by RTO or an accredited driving training school)
expiry_consequence: Licence not issued without a passed driving test, unless from a Government-accredited driving school (exemption)

service_or_situation: Driving licence renewal
document_name: Existing (expiring/expired) Driving Licence
renewal_window: 30 days before expiry to 1 year after expiry, commonly cited (NOT_VERIFIED exact window)
expiry_consequence: Late fee and/or requirement to reapply as new if renewed beyond the grace window

service_or_situation: International Driving Permit application
document_name: Valid Indian Driving Licence
expiry_consequence: Application rejected without a valid underlying Indian DL

service_or_situation: New vehicle registration
document_name: Sale certificate/invoice from the dealer
expiry_consequence: Registration cannot be completed without proof of sale

service_or_situation: New vehicle registration (interim period before permanent RC is issued)
document_name: Temporary Registration Certificate
expiry_consequence: Vehicle should not be driven in public place once temporary registration lapses without permanent RC

service_or_situation: New vehicle registration
document_name: Pollution Under Control Certificate (where applicable at first registration)
expiry_consequence: Registration processing may be delayed without PUC where required

service_or_situation: New vehicle registration
document_name: Certificate of Insurance
accepted_digital_platform: Vahan portal (insurer-uploaded via Insurance Information Board)
expiry_consequence: Registration not completed without proof of valid insurance

service_or_situation: Registration renewal for a private vehicle after the initial 15-year period
document_name: Fitness Certificate (private vehicles beyond prescribed age)
validity_period: commonly cited as 5 years per renewal beyond 15 years (NOT_VERIFIED exact CMVR rule)
expiry_consequence: Vehicle may not be re-registered without a valid fitness certificate

service_or_situation: Ownership (RC) transfer for a vehicle under hypothecation/loan
document_name: No-Objection Certificate from the financing bank/institution
expiry_consequence: Transfer cannot be processed while hypothecation is active without financier NOC

service_or_situation: Ownership (RC) transfer
document_name: Notice/report of transfer of ownership (CMVR-prescribed forms)
validity_period: must be reported within a prescribed period of the transfer (exact number of days NOT_VERIFIED)
expiry_consequence: Continuing liability/registration issues for the previous owner if transfer not reported in time

service_or_situation: Goods carriage permit application
document_name: Registration Certificate copy, valid insurance, valid fitness certificate, and tax payment proof
expiry_consequence: Permit application rejected without these supporting documents

service_or_situation: Initial fitness certificate for a transport vehicle
document_name: Registration Certificate, insurance, and PUC certificate
validity_period: 2 years for a new transport vehicle (commonly cited, NOT_VERIFIED)
expiry_consequence: Vehicle deemed unfit to ply without a valid fitness certificate

service_or_situation: Fitness certificate renewal for a transport vehicle
document_name: Existing fitness certificate, current RC, insurance, and PUC certificate
expiry_consequence: Vehicle deemed unfit to ply without renewed certificate

service_or_situation: Filing a motor accident compensation claim
document_name: First Information Report (FIR) or police accident report
expiry_consequence: Claim may face additional scrutiny or delay without a police report, though not always an absolute bar (case-law dependent)

service_or_situation: Filing a motor accident compensation claim (injury)
document_name: Medical treatment records/discharge summary/disability certificate
accepted_digital_platform: Hospital-issued (digital copies generally accepted by Tribunals)
expiry_consequence: Compensation quantum for injury/disability difficult to establish without medical evidence

service_or_situation: Filing a motor accident compensation claim (death)
document_name: Post-mortem report and death certificate
expiry_consequence: Death-related compensation claim difficult to establish without these documents

service_or_situation: Duplicate RC application (lost/damaged)
document_name: Police report/FIR of loss (or affidavit of loss), and any available copy of the original RC
expiry_consequence: Application rejected without proof of loss

service_or_situation: Duplicate driving licence application (lost/damaged)
document_name: Police report/FIR of loss (or affidavit of loss), and existing DL number
expiry_consequence: Application rejected without proof of loss

service_or_situation: Bharat (BH) series registration application for employees with multi-state postings
document_name: Employment certificate from a Government department, PSU, or a private company with offices in four or more States/UTs
expiry_consequence: Application not eligible for BH-series without qualifying employment certificate

service_or_situation: Voluntary vehicle scrapping/deregistration at a Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facility
document_name: Original Registration Certificate
expiry_consequence: Deregistration/scrapping certificate not issued without surrender of the RC

service_or_situation: Licence application for a 16-18 year old applicant (gearless motorcycle up to prescribed engine capacity)
document_name: Guardians identity proof and written consent
expiry_consequence: Application rejected without guardian consent for a minor applicant
